entries.removal_criteria: Registered budget-effect targets receive a dedicated target-migration packet and source, runtime-string, wheel, documentation, effect-registry, monkeypatch, and pickle audits show no remaining compatibility caller.
Source, runtime-string, wheel, documentation, effect-registry, monkeypatch, and pickle audits show no remaining implementation caller after one supported compatibility release.
A dedicated packet proves old imports and pickle names absent, preserves registry identity, and replaces the retained source without weakening owner approval.
All callers use responsibility modules and a clean wheel import audit observes no facade imports.

Source, runtime-string, wheel, documentation, effect-registry, and pickle audits show no callers of the lane, worktree, or chip-publication compatibility facades; the registered effect targets and anchors remain unchanged.
The replacement CLI is packaged and effect-registry plus wheel audits show no remaining legacy target.

Source, runtime-string, wheel, documentation, monkeypatch, and pickle audits show no remaining provider-report import through the orchestration module; AgentTask and RunState stay with their orchestration owner.

Registered provider targets receive dedicated target-migration packets and source, runtime-string, wheel, documentation, effect-registry, monkeypatch, executable-object, and pickle audits show no remaining catalogue caller through the legacy package.
Provider source, runtime-string, wheel, documentation, monkeypatch, and pickle audits show no helper imports through the legacy module after one supported compatibility release.
Source, runtime-string, wheel, documentation, monkeypatch, and pickle audits show no remaining legacy contract import after one supported compatibility release.

A dedicated target-migration packet preserves the Effect Registry digest and authenticated invoke/output source locators, while source, runtime-string, wheel, documentation, executable-object, and pickle audits show no remaining legacy contract import.
Source, runtime-string, wheel, documentation, monkeypatch, and pickle audits show no remaining legacy persona import; the verified legacy JSON mirror may then be retired separately.
Source, wheel, and runtime-string audits show no compatibility imports and fault-contract object identities remain stable.

Source, runtime-string, wheel, documentation, monkeypatch, and pickle audits show no remaining caller importing kernel contracts, agent tasks, or provider reports through this module; each caller names the owning module directly. The kernel is already migrated by G1-HIER-10 and the boundary contract forbids it from returning.

A dedicated target-migration packet changes the Effect Registry intentionally and source, runtime-string, wheel, documentation, effect-registry, monkeypatch, and pickle audits show no remaining compatibility caller.
